rules.statement: A claimant of a servitude must establish the claim by clear and satisfactory evidence of the strongest kind, including clear and unmistakable evidence of the commencement of an adverse user for the prescribed period.
rules.supporting_quote: Clear and unmistakable evidence of the commencement of an adverse user thereafter for the prescriptive period is necessary to entitle the licensee to claim a servitude in respect of the premises.
